title: Unprinted Half a Camel Brochure (Brighton Fringe 2025)
description: 90-page brochure designed by Ben Carter for Half a Camel's Brighton Fringe 2025 programme. The brochure was never printed due to uncertainty caused by institutional instability, unresolved safeguarding concerns, and lack of support from Brighton Fringe and Sussex Police. Despite the emotional and logistical labour poured into the design, the material was never able to go to print.
personal_note: Up all night for weeks getting this done as well as trying to juggle everyone and everything — keeping it all together along what would end up to be a dead-end path, which I was willing to climb.
